lode.description: Select the LED mode for the digital output.

allowed_values.Off: Off turns off the LED completely
allowed_values.Alarm: Alarm sets the LED for alarm notifications
allowed_values.Energy: Energy sets the LED for energy pulsing

energy_channel.description: Select which accumulated energy channel to monitor and use for energy pulsing. Ignored when LED mode is set to Alarm.

pulse_weight_per_kwh.description: When configured for energy pulsing, this setting defines how many pulses are sent to the LED for every 1 kWh, 1 kVARh or 1 kVAh accumulated energy. Ignored when LED mode is set to Alarm.
